title: refactor(service-automation): move 42 engine bodies into five seam modules (#25222 slice 7)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCEzLkAB12FfRHL9ipwfKPd)_

Part of #25222
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

This is slice 7 of the `engine.ts` split. Its claim is comment 6378948491, narrowed by one body in comment 6379054858. It follows the seat's shape call A: one PR, five seam modules. The bodies of 42 `AutomationEngine` methods move, unedited, into five new modules under `packages/services/service-automation/src/`:

| Module | Host | Bodies | What they do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dispatch-claims.ts` | `DispatchClaimsHost` | 7 | `claim`, `claimInProcess`, `settleDispatch`, `readDispatch`, `nextRunId`, `warnAdvanceClaimDegraded`, `releaseSuspension`: claiming, settling and reading a dispatch, minting a run id, announcing a degraded advance claim, releasing a suspension |
| `flow-definitions.ts` | `FlowDefinitionsHost` | 12 | `resolveFunction`, `registerConnectorProvider`, `canonicalizeStoredFlow`, `canonicalizeFlow`, `unregisterFlow`, `recordFlowRefusal`, `getFlowRuntimeStates`, `describeUnboundReason`, `getTriggerBindingAudit`, `flowCredentialHoldings`, `hookSecretResolver`, `rollbackFlow`: canonicalising, unregistering, refusing and rolling back a flow; its runtime states and trigger bindings; its function, connector-provider and credential surfaces |
| `subflow-guards.ts` | `SubflowGuardsHost` | 11 | `describeDisabledFlow`, `subflowTargets`, `packagedSubflowCallers`, `parkedRunsOf`, `refuseUnderReachingCallers`, `disabledPackagedSubflows`, `ledgerDisabledChainReaches`, `refuseEnableOntoDisabledSubflow`, `describeDisabledSubflows`, `rejudgeSubflowCallers`, `refuseCustomerAuthoredToggle`: finding and describing disabled or packaged subflows and their callers, and refusing what would reach a disabled subflow |
| `consumed-suspension-restore.ts` | `ConsumedSuspensionRestoreHost` | 6 | `rowSupersedesJournal`, `resolveConsumedSuspensionWitnesses`, `restoreConsumedSuspension`, `resolveRestoreChain`, `peekConsumedSuspension`, `inspectConsumedSuspension`: resolving a consumed suspension's witnesses, and restoring, peeking at or inspecting one |
| `node-text-rendering.ts` | `NodeTextRenderingHost` | 6 | `unknownNodeTypes`, `warnIfNodeTypeVocabularyNeverSealed`, `setNodeError`, `renderRefusalMessage`, `renderFlowTextSlot`, `translatedFlowTemplate`: the node-type vocabulary checks a run makes, a failed node's error variable, and rendering refusal messages and flow text slots |

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for the later slices. The branch is `claude/project-thread-nirtwt`, which the harness pins for this session. It was restarted from `main` at `ea6fe000` after slice 6 (#25567) merged. The branch name has no issue number, so the claim comment is the identity record.

## Scope

- **The 33-site question.** The ruling on the 33 `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` sites in 21 methods is still pending with Sales. This slice moves **0** of those sites, because none of the 42 bodies holds one. `check-tenant-audit-census` and `check-system-context-census` give byte-identical output at base and head (see Readers).
- **Return types.** Each of the 42 methods declares its return type; the generator refuses one that does not. So no public body with an inferred return type moves.
- **Four bodies stay**, because each reads a name that `engine.ts` documents as private, and moving it would mean exporting that name:
  - `claimAdvance` returns `AdvanceClaim`, whose docblock says "Module-private: it is a control-flow verdict, not a contract."
  - `validateNodeInputSchemas` throws `InputSchemaViolationError`, whose docblock says "Not exported on purpose — callers read the ADR-0112 `code` off the result, never the throw."
  - `refuseInvalidScreenInput` and `buildSubflowResumeSignal` (slice 6's two) read `ENGINE_BUILT_SIGNAL` / `engineBuilt`. `docs/adr/0019-approval-as-flow-node.md` calls it "a module-private symbol", and its docblock says "Module-private and symbol-keyed".
- **`pullConnectorSource` stays too** (the claim amendment, comment 6379054858). `connector-pull.ts` already has a top-level `pullConnectorSource`, which `index.ts` re-exports. With the method's body moved as well, the bundle held two top-level functions of that name, and the bundler renamed the public one: both bundles exported `pullConnectorSource2 as pullConnectorSource`, so its `.name` changed. That would be an observable change to a public export, so the body stays. On this head, every exported function's `.name` matches base in both bundles (see Bundles below).
- **None of the other stays moves.** The remaining-bodies table (comment 6376268510) marks these as stays:
  - for liveness, `retryExecution` and `getConnectorDescriptors`;
  - for private statics, `resolveCanonicalDescriptor`, `resolveResumeAuthority` and `resolveEffectiveSuspension`. A moved function reading a private static would not compile, and `tsc` passes;
  - for the startup-registry gate, `knownNodeTypes`, `getUnknownNodeTypeAudit`, `sealNodeTypeVocabulary` and `warnUnknownNodeTypes`.
- **Size.** 2,406 changed lines, under the 3,000-line bar: `engine.ts` +365 / -771, the five modules +1,268, and the test 1 / 1. `check-governed-merges --branch` on this commit says NOT governed, 0 of 7 paths on the register.

## What stays in `engine.ts`

- Every moved method keeps its name, docblock, signature and position in the class, because tsup emits each member, private ones included, into the published `.d.ts`.

## The shape (slices 1 to 6)

- **The host interfaces.** Each module's host holds exactly the members its bodies read, each typed as the class member itself (`AutomationEngine['m']`), so a renamed member is a compile error. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
  - Each moved function types `this` as the `Pick` of its host over exactly the members its own body reads, read off each body's AST in first-read order.
  - Six bodies read no member and are called directly, without a host: `nextRunId`, `subflowTargets`, `describeDisabledSubflows`, `rowSupersedesJournal`, `unknownNodeTypes` and `setNodeError`.
- **Methods** are passed as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`, so a spy or test double set on the instance is still the one called.
- **Six fields go through a getter**, in the `store` form (#25223 cut 1, PR #25290), because a method reassigns each. The write sites are `engine.ts` at the base `ea6fe000`:
  - `flowDispatchStore`: `setFlowDispatchStore` (`:2778`);
  - `functionResolver`: `setFunctionResolver` (`:3962`);
  - `flowCredentialSource`: `setFlowCredentialSource` (`:4746`);
  - `store`: `setSuspendedRunStore` (`:2769`), and the constructor (`:2745`);
  - `nodeTypeVocabularySealed`: `sealNodeTypeVocabulary` (`:9424`);
  - `i18nServiceSource`: `setI18nServiceSource` (`:4769`).

  For each one, the stub builds `const readX = () => this.X;` and the host member `get X() { return readX(); }`. Each read in the body reads the engine's current value, as it did inside the class.
- **Four warned-once flags go through a get/set pair** (#25224 cut 10, PR #25508), because a moved body sets each. The stub adds `const writeX = (v: AutomationEngine['X']) => { this.X = v; };` and the host member `set X(v) { writeX(v); }` beside the getter, and the host interface member is not `readonly`. So each write lands on the engine, as it did through `this`.
  - `git grep -nE "(dispatchClaimDegradationWarned|dispatchOutcomeDegradationWarned|advanceClaimDegradationWarned|nodeTypeSealOmissionWarned)"` over the whole repo at the base finds 13 lines, all in `engine.ts`:
    - the four declarations, each `= false`: `nodeTypeSealOmissionWarned` (`:2540`), `dispatchClaimDegradationWarned` (`:2725`), `advanceClaimDegradationWarned` (`:2734`), `dispatchOutcomeDegradationWarned` (`:2741`);
    - one `{@link}` in a docblock (`:2544`);
    - the four writes, each in the one moved body that sets it: `claim` (`:2815`), `readDispatch` (`:2911`), `warnAdvanceClaimDegraded` (`:3310`), `warnIfNodeTypeVocabularyNeverSealed` (`:9481`);
    - the four reads just above those writes, in the same bodies.
  - The constructor writes none of them, and no other file names any of them.
- **Fifteen fields go by value**: `logger`, `inProcessDispatchClaims`, `nodeExecutors`, `connectorProviders`, `flows`, `flowRefusals`, `flowShadowing`, `boundFlowTriggers`, `policyDisabledFlows`, `subflowDeclinedFlows`, `triggers`, `flowVersionHistory`, `flowLedgerDisabled`, `flowStatusDisabled` and `consumedSuspensions`. The seat asked for proof that none is reassigned after construction:
  - `git grep -nE "this\.(FIELDS)\s*(=[^=>]|\?\?=|\|\|=|&&=)" -- packages/services/service-automation/src`, with the fifteen names, finds 1 line, in the constructor: `this.logger = logger;` (`:2744`).
  - Across the repo, the same pattern on any receiver (`\.(FIELDS)`) for the fourteen names other than `logger` finds nothing. The bracket form, `['name']` followed by `=` or `??=`, finds nothing for any of the fifteen. And `\.(flows|triggers|logger)\s*(=[^=>]|\?\?=)` on any receiver in the package finds only that constructor line.
  - The bodies change the collections' contents in place, on the engine's own `Map`s and `Set`s, and never rebind the fields.
- **Async.** The stubs of the nine async methods drop `async` and return the moved function's promise, as in slices 3 to 6.
  - The caller gets the very promise the body makes.
  - Dropping `async` is the only edit to those signature lines, and the `.d.ts` does not print `async`.
- **Parameter defaults.** `canonicalizeStoredFlow` and `canonicalizeFlow` take `options: { includeRetired?: boolean } = {}`.
  - The class stub keeps that default exactly as written, so a caller that omits `options` still gets `{}`.
  - The moved text keeps it too, token-identical, because the moved lines are unedited. That default is now dead: the stub always passes `options`, already defaulted. It is disclosed here, not edited.
- The moved bodies keep saying `this.`, so the moved lines are unedited.

## Module-level declarations and imports

- **Seven helpers gain `export`, in place.** The moved bodies read them, so each module imports them from `./engine.js`. Nothing else about them changes: the same line, the same docblock, the same position. `index.ts` adds no re-export, and the package's export map is `.` only, so none of them is reachable from outside the package. The signatures at head:
  - `export const CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION: readonly string[] = [` (read by `canonicalizeFlow`)
  - `export const MAX_RESTORE_CHAIN_HOPS = 32;` (read by `resolveRestoreChain`)
  - `export function chainEntryOf(runId: string, result: SuspensionRestoreResult): ChainRestoreEntry {` (read by `restoreConsumedSuspension`)
  - `export function flowRegistrationTodo(flowName: string, site: RegistrationCheckSite): ConversionTodoNotice {` (read by `canonicalizeStoredFlow`)
  - `export function graftConditionEnvelopes(converted: unknown, parsed: unknown): unknown {` (read by `canonicalizeFlow`)
  - `export function negotiatedServiceLocale(service: RefusalI18nService, requested: string): string {` (read by `translatedFlowTemplate`)
  - `export function nestedChildRunId(correlation: string | undefined): string | undefined {` (read by `resolveRestoreChain`)
  - None of their docblocks says the name is private. Two other files place `CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION` "in `service-automation/src/engine.ts`" (`metadata-core`'s `artifact-forward-conversion.ts` and `metadata-protocol`'s `protocol.ts`), and it stays there.
  - **The cut-6 trap.** `flowRegistrationTodo`'s signature names types from other files (`RegistrationCheckSite`, `ConversionTodoNotice`). On this PR the rolled-up `.d.ts` gains no declaration and moves none; its only raw change is 87 reordered string-literal unions, each shown below as a swap.
  - The ESM and CJS export lists are identical at base and head (39 names each, ESM equal to CJS on each side). They are listed in the `.d.ts` section.
- **The modules' imports** use the same specifiers as `engine.ts`'s own imports. A comment above each value import from `./engine.js` says the value is read only inside function bodies, at call time, so the import cycle is safe under ESM live bindings, as in slices 3, 5 and 6. The tsup bundle is one file and has no cycle.
- **Import edits in `engine.ts`.**
  - `import { FLOW_HOOK_SECRET_KEY, flowCredentialClassLabel, flowCredentialPositions } from './flow-credential-projection.js';` moves, verbatim, to `flow-definitions.ts`: only moved bodies read those names.
  - The 6-line `[#15788]` comment and `import { renderTextSlot, FlowTextTemplateError } from './builtin/template.js';` move, verbatim, to `node-text-rendering.ts`. The comment's claim ("`template.ts` imports only `../guard-refusal.js` and package-external contracts, so nothing it pulls in reaches back here") is as true there as it was in `engine.ts`.
  - Three imports are narrowed to the names `engine.ts` still reads:
    - `@objectstack/spec/automation` keeps `FLOW_RESERVED_NODE_TYPES` and `FLOW_STRUCTURAL_NODE_TYPES`; `FlowSchema`, `validateControlFlow` and `collectFlowGraphs` go to the modules;
    - `@objectstack/spec` keeps `CONVERSION_TODO_CODE` and the types `ConversionNotice` and `ConversionTodoNotice`; `applyConversionsToFlow` goes to `flow-definitions.ts`;
    - `@objectstack/spec/system` keeps `resolveBundleLocale`; `flowRefusalMessageKey` goes to `node-text-rendering.ts`.
  - No `engine.ts` docblock `{@link}`s any of the names that left, so no link stops resolving. `tsc` with `noUnusedLocals` passes, so every name left in an `engine.ts` import is still read or linked.
  - `engine.ts` gains the five module imports, after the `./run-resume.js` one, each with a comment naming its bodies.
- **Authored text.** Each module's docblock and its host interface's docblock are new. Each host docblock names the method that reassigns each getter field and the body that sets each get/set flag.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved block.** This is `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change ea6fe000 HEAD` over `engine.ts` and the five modules. It detects 752 of the 771 deleted lines and 892 of the 1,633 added lines as moved.
  - **Deleted, not moved (19):**
    - the signature heads of the nine async methods, each of which drops `async`;
    - the seven helper declaration lines, each of which gains `export`;
    - the three import lines that are narrowed.
  - **Added, not moved (741):** the modules' docblocks, imports and host interfaces; the 42 pointer docblocks and rewritten function heads; the five module imports in `engine.ts` and their comments; the narrowed imports; the nine heads without `async`; the seven `export` lines; the 42 stub bodies; and lines git does not pair with a moved block.
- **An independent check.** A script compared base and head `engine.ts` against the five modules.
  - **Module lines.** 898 of the modules' 1,268 lines are in 43 verbatim runs of base `engine.ts`: the 42 method texts, de-indented one level, and the `[#15788]` comment with its `./builtin/template.js` import. The script names each of the other 370:
    - 278 head lines: per module, the copyright line, the docblock, the imports and their comments, the host docblock and the host interface (10, 22, 15, 9 and 6 members);
    - the 42 pointer docblocks;
    - 50 signature lines: 42 `export function` heads, and 8 `this` parameter lines, each a `Pick` of the host.
  - **Deleted lines.** Every line deleted from `engine.ts` (771 in all, 9 of them blank) is among the modules' lines, apart from the 19 above. The deleted `./flow-credential-projection.js` import, the `[#15788]` comment and the `./builtin/template.js` import are among them, verbatim.
  - **Added lines.** Of the 365 lines added to `engine.ts`, 284 are found nowhere in base:
    - the five module import blocks (47 lines) and their comments (17);
    - the three narrowed imports and the seven `export` lines;
    - the nine heads without `async`;
    - the stub lines: 42 pointer comments, 36 host literals with their 36 calls, 35 method closures, 16 by-value members, 15 read/write closures, 15 getter and setter members, and 6 direct calls.

    The other 81, such as `logger: this.logger,` and `};`, are lines base already contains elsewhere.
  - **Literals.** No string or template literal in the 42 method bodies spans a line, checked on the TypeScript AST of base `engine.ts`. So de-indenting changed no string value.
- **Tests.** `@objectstack/service-automation`'s suite passes the same at base and head, 199 of 199 files and 2628 of 2628 tests.

## `.d.ts` reading (ruling 6348891160, item 2)

The merge base is `ea6fe000`, the head of `main`, so the merge-base reading and the base reading are one reading.

- **Base** is `dist/`, built at `ea6fe000` in this container, in a worktree of that commit.
- **Head** is `dist/`, built at this PR's commit.
- The package's dependencies were built by `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/service-automation` (31 of 31 tasks), and both sides resolve the same built dependencies.

The readings:

- **Raw sha256**, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`, which are identical to each other on both sides: base `1a5162a4dd929399460a3936e22747a74cf0a8db24d398ffbab5d7ead7bf212e`, head `deb08bdfb32c2a247b98780ad67162bd2938da46669e81af313526f69af6ecc4`.
- **Normalised sha256**, all four files: base `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`, head `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`.
- **Raw diff**, `index.d.ts` base vs head: **174 lines**, 87 per side, with 19,626 lines on each side. They are 87 one-line `c` hunks: each base line and its head line are the same line with one string-literal union's members in another order. Outside the union, each pair is byte-identical, and each union holds the same members on both sides.
- **The 87 pairs**, which are five distinct swaps. All of them sit inside three declarations, `SysAutomationRun`, `SysFlowDispatch` and `SysFlowCredential`, which inline the spec's field and flow types:

  | Member | Union | The swap | Lines (base = head) |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | `type:` | 49 field types | `"secret"` moves from 3rd to 6th, after `"code"` | 5851, 6366, 13468, 13983, 15679, 16194 |
  | `dialect:` | `"cron" \| "cel" \| "template"` | `"template"` moves from 3rd to 1st | 72 lines: 5889, 5933, 5942, 5976, 6002, 6011, 6020, 6033, 6043, 6088, 6097, 6109, 6118, 6130, 6139, 6151, 6160, 6202, 6396, 6428, 6756, 6775, 6829, 6840, 13506, 13550, 13559, 13593, 13619, 13628, 13637, 13650, 13660, 13705, 13714, 13726, 13735, 13747, 13756, 13768, 13777, 13819, 14013, 14045, 14373, 14392, 14446, 14457, 15717, 15761, 15770, 15804, 15830, 15839, 15848, 15861, 15871, 15916, 15925, 15937, 15946, 15958, 15967, 15979, 15988, 16030, 16224, 16256, 16584, 16603, 16657, 16668 |
  | `type?:` | 6 action types | `"form"` and `"api"` swap (2nd and 3rd) | 6720, 14337, 16548 |
  | `type?:` | 49 field types | `"secret"` moves from 3rd to 6th, after `"code"` | 6747, 14364, 16575 |
  | `category?:` | 7 categories | `"flow"` and `"data"` swap (1st and 2nd) | 6858, 14475, 16686 |

  For example, line 5889 is `dialect: "cron" | "cel" | "template";` at base and `dialect: "template" | "cron" | "cel";` at head. A script checked each of the 87 pairs: it replaced each union with a placeholder and compared the rest of the line, and it compared each union's sorted members. All 87 are swaps, 0 are not.
- **The normaliser**, the ruling's one-liner, verbatim:
  `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`
- **Positive controls**, each one line changed in the head `index.d.ts`, then the same normaliser:
  - Line 1865, `private claimInProcess;`, a private member whose body moved, made public (`claimInProcess;`): `196ae606dce0584f296ce860802b020ab52eb604cde3f4f09cb835f5deba1b0c`.
  - The same member renamed (`private claimInProcessRenamed;`): `a972fa4d01a6a8cd8654a4ce08619a48df26fe4745758cc0bcfca4c9edf4bf4d`.
  - Line 5889 with one union member changed (`"cel"` to `"cel2"`): `a21f02dba31881caec16bae8623f780cc6aae2cc9cd56f110d7eb0cb4a66b188`.
  - All three differ from `0df32585…`. So the normaliser does not hide a visibility change, a rename or a changed union member; it hides only member order.
- **Item 1 holds:**
  - (a) the declaration set and visibility are the same: no line is added, removed or moved, and the 87 changed lines change only member order;
  - (b) the files are byte-identical after the normalisation;
  - (c) the ESM and CJS export lists are identical;
  - (d) every raw-diff line is a union-member swap.

## Bundles

- **Export lists.** 39 names each, identical at base and at head, and ESM equal to CJS on each side: `AutomationEngine`, `AutomationServicePlugin`, `CONNECTOR_PULL_PROVIDERS`, `ConnectorPullError`, `DEFAULT_MAX_EXECUTION_LOG_SIZE`, `DEFAULT_MAX_TERMINAL_RUNS_PER_FLOW`, `FLOW_CREDENTIAL_MIGRATION_ID`, `FLOW_CREDENTIAL_OBJECT`, `FLOW_CREDENTIAL_VALUE_FIELD`, `FlowCredentialChannel`, `FlowCredentialChannelRefusal`, `FlowCredentialUnresolvableError`, `InMemoryFlowActivationStore`, `InMemoryFlowDispatchStore`, `InMemorySuspendedRunStore`, `MAX_PERSISTED_HISTORY_STEPS`, `ObjectStoreFlowActivationStore`, `ObjectStoreFlowDispatchStore`, `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`, `SysAutomationRun`, `SysFlowCredential`, `SysFlowDispatch`, `UnscopedRunDataAccessError`, `createPackageFileLoader`, `describeFlowContender`, `formatRunSummaryLine`, `installBuiltinNodes`, `migrateFlowCredentialsIntoChannel`, `pullConnectorSource`, `registerConnectorNodes`, `registerCrudNodes`, `registerHttpNodes`, `registerLogicNodes`, `registerScreenNodes`, `renderFlowContender`, `resolveFlowPrecedence`, `resolveRunDataContext`, `stampSystemInsertOwner`, `summarizeRun`.
- **Each export's code.** A script fingerprinted each export's `Function#toString` in both bundles, at base and at head. Only `AutomationEngine` differs, because its stubs changed. In the CJS bundle, six other functions (`migrateFlowCredentialsIntoChannel` and the five `register*Nodes`) print differently too, but only in esbuild's import-namespace variable names (`import_automation3` becomes another number, because the new modules add import statements). With those names folded, they are identical.
- **Each export's name.** Every exported function's `.name` matches base in both bundles. (`AutomationEngine` prints as `_AutomationEngine` at both ends.) This is the check that caught `pullConnectorSource`; see Scope.
- The bundle JS bytes otherwise differ only because code moved within the bundle.

## Readers

**One reader re-pointed.** `src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`'s `ENGINE_SOURCES` holds the #10243 grep pins, which are absence checks. It gains the five modules, so a moved body is not a place the retired mechanism could come back unseen. That 1-line edit is the PR's seventh file.

**Readers examined.** The base for each is `ea6fe000`, in a worktree of that commit.

- **`check-tenant-audit-census`** (derived): output byte-identical to base.
  - It certifies 238 write call sites (162 decidable; 2 provably without tenant context, 29 more unreadable).
  - It holds 23 prose figures and matches every `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row.
  - Its `--self-test` output is identical too.
- **`check-system-context-census`** (derived): output byte-identical. It finds 149 elevation read sites in 22 packages across 77 files, in 129 symbols.
- **`check:liveness`** (spec lane, not derived; run by hand as `packages/spec`'s `tsx scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts`): output byte-identical at base and head.
  - 753 (entry, cited file) pairs: 752 anchored, 1 exempt.
  - 982 of 982 symbol anchors resolve.
- **`check:platform-checklist`** (not derived; run by hand): output identical at base and head. 987 of 997 symbol anchors resolve; the other 10 are the same ones, the named #16898 residual.
- **`check-adr-symbol-anchors`** (not derived; run by hand): output identical at base and head. 2384 anchors across 142 records resolve.
- **`check:adr-anchors`** (decision letters; run by hand at the merge base and the head): output identical apart from the count of files holding a citation, 6699 at base and 6702 at head.
  - The 52309 citations are the same in number: the citations in the moved bodies of `flow-definitions.ts`, `subflow-guards.ts` and `node-text-rendering.ts` are now counted in those three files.
  - It reads 84 anchored files and 1939 decision-letter citations, the same at both ends.
  - Neither `engine.ts` nor any of the five modules is on the anchored surface.
- **`check:startup-registry-verdict`** (not derived; run by hand at both ends, on the hand-gate list): 46 seams, 40 of them read-only, none recording a verdict, at base and at head.
  - Its `--list` is the same at both ends apart from line numbers and the scanned-file count, 3463 at base and 3468 at head; the five extra files are the new modules.
  - None of its four engine bodies moves. `warnIfNodeTypeVocabularyNeverSealed` and `unknownNodeTypes` move, and the `registerFlow` and `sealNodeTypeVocabulary` seams still name the same `warn` sites, at their new line numbers.
- **Symbol anchors into moved methods.** Four anchors name a method whose body moved:
  - `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`, `engine.ts#canonicalizeStoredFlow`;
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`, `engine.ts#packagedSubflowCallers`;
  - `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`, `engine.ts#renderRefusalMessage` and `engine.ts#translatedFlowTemplate`.

  Each still resolves: the method stays in `engine.ts` with its docblock and calls its body. This is the same as slice 5's `engine.ts#recordLog` anchor in `approvals.json`. The readers above give identical output, and the `translation.json` key-mention pairs (`refusals`, `message`) stay anchored through `engine.ts`'s own docblocks.
- **`path:line` citations.** None points into this package's `engine.ts` at a line this slice moves. The one fixture citation, `service-automation/src/engine.ts:44` in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/evidence.test.ts`, is a realm-attribution string that `scanEvidence` parses without reading the file.

## Gates
